title: Panthers 37 @ Bengals 37 (OT) · 2014 Week 6

song.title: IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King
song.credit: Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46: IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King (Edvard Grieg), Czech National Symphony Orchestra, Public Domain Mark 1.0, via www.classicals.de

captions.text: Bengals kicker Mike Nugent: good from 44 before the half.
Fourth quarter. The offenses trade touchdowns.
Four minutes left. The Bengals tie it, 31–31.
A Bengals touchdown is wiped out by a penalty.
Carolina drives, and converts on fourth down.
Five seconds left. Panthers kicker Graham Gano ties it, 34–34.
They run the clock down to two seconds.

story: Two kickers trade field goals. The last one misses.
why_song: In the Hall of the Mountain King creeps along, then repeats one tune, louder each time, until it bursts. The end of this game did the same: kick, answer, kick, answer, then the miss.
